reply.summary: Saiaton is a scarred syndicate lieutenant who runs smuggling crews for a wine-named crime boss across several borders. Saiaton relies on blunt boxing and a loyal gang, and has learned that muscle alone loses to a prisoner who refuses to stay locked up.

feats.scene: Saiaton lands a heavy cross that drops a rival enforcer across a warehouse table.
Saiaton stays conscious through a savage beating that leaves him barely alive.

reply.summary: Citior is a tired homicide detective in a crime-ridden harbour city who works cases beside the old police chief. Citior unmasks a scheming rival inside the department and finally weighs a job elsewhere, away from the grisly killings that wear her down.

feats.scene: Citior fires a single pistol round that drops a fleeing clown-faced killer.
Citior is dragged hostage by thugs yet stays calm under a threat of poison gas.

reply.summary: Milinstu is a tall, broad embassy liaison who handles security for an international hero league in a snowy capital. Milinstu keeps sharp watch over visitors and diplomats, and her family ties anchor her far more than any title does.

feats.scene: Milinstu hurls a would-be intruder bodily through the embassy gate.
Milinstu shrugs off a thrown chair and keeps her post at the door.

reply.summary: Tumtor is a bright college student whose engagement to a masked young crimefighter pulls her into danger she chose to share. Tumtor guards his secret fiercely, and steps between a violent sibling and their wounded father when nobody else will.

feats.scene: Tumtor slaps a bully hard enough to rock his head sideways.
Tumtor stands unflinching in front of a raving gang leader armed with a blade.

reply.summary: Anuser is a restless student in a neon-lit future city who grows weary of a boyfriend who keeps vanishing on mysterious errands. Anuser asks hard questions about where his job will lead, never guessing what he truly does at night.

feats.scene: Anuser throws a textbook across a hallway in frustration.
Anuser walks away from a nasty fall on wet stairs with only bruises.

reply.summary: Luterter is a brown-haired island warrior trained by a sisterhood blessed by two huntress goddesses. Luterter shoots, rides and fences with equal skill, and holds a beach against mechanical invaders during a world-spanning crisis.

feats.scene: Luterter cleaves a charging machine soldier in half with one sword stroke.
Luterter takes a blast of shrapnel on her bracers and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Vatersau is a pale-eyed assassin serving a vast state, hunting hidden sages while posing as an ordinary woman to seduce her prey. Vatersau fights with a blade and bare hands, and a runner who strikes at her kidney with focused inner force finally brings her down.

feats.scene: Vatersau slashes through a heavy bamboo screen and the dummy behind it.
Vatersau shakes off a speed-driven kick and counterattacks at once.

reply.summary: Lloseson is an inventor who shrinks to doll size after his own chamber misfires, then dons a jetpack suit armed with lasers to rescue a lifelong friend. Lloseson later becomes her sidekick and loyal partner in a spectral crusade against an organised crime clan.

feats.scene: Lloseson burns a hole through a steel locker door with a tiny laser.
Lloseson survives being swatted across a room by a gunman.

reply.summary: Tasstron is an asthmatic future teen who hears voices nobody else can, and learns they are earlier speedsters guiding her through a cosmic current of velocity. Tasstron inherits the fastest mantle, running through a city that once drove her family away.

feats.scene: Tasstron slams into a runaway truck at full sprint and flips it over.
Tasstron skids across a highway at blinding pace and rises unhurt.
Tasstron outruns a shock wave down an empty avenue.

reply.summary: Stsere is a bearded frontier hunter, scout and road-builder who tracks game and enemies through endless forest on horseback. Stsere shoots a flintlock with calm precision, founds settlements and leads militias across mountains few settlers dared cross.

feats.scene: Stsere fires his long musket and drops a charging bull elk.
Stsere endures a day-long forced march through freezing rain.

reply.summary: Tireonan is a red-skinned street enforcer who unites rival neighbourhood gangs into one syndicate after a monstrous raid leaves the old mob families weak. Tireonan sells drugs, courts the council of crime elders and stays one step ahead of the police.

feats.scene: Tireonan hits a defiant dealer so hard that the man folds onto the pavement.
Tireonan takes a crowbar across the ribs and keeps issuing orders.

reply.summary: Natorlli is a stunt performer who bargains with a stranger for a starring role and finds he is cursed to burst into flame if he leaves the swampy town. Natorlli later gains blue fire from a mad scientist's injection and struggles to control it.

feats.scene: Natorlli unleashes a gush of cobalt fire that melts a parked sedan.
Natorlli walks out of a blazing garage with his skin glowing but unburned.

reply.summary: Iumsu is a red-haired telepath summoned by a caped champion to carry him across the veil to a sorcerous realm. Iumsu works spells of dimensional travel and mental force from behind the scenes of a brutal tyrant's regime.

feats.scene: Iumsu hurls a stack of crates across an alley with a flick of thought.
Iumsu staggers but stays upright after a gunman's pistol-whipping.

reply.summary: Amocor is a poor farmer's son who receives a magic lantern from a fairy and becomes a pumpkin-headed hero in an international team. Amocor drifts into a dictator's army, switches loyalties twice, and dies of old age, passing his mantle to a cousin.

feats.scene: Amocor flings a burst of lantern light that blasts a door off its hinges.
Amocor endures a prison cell's daily beatings without breaking.

reply.summary: Lorseeo is a gourd-headed hero who offers his services through a phone app and is booked for parties and rescues alike. Lorseeo fights a power-stealing android in a foreign capital, and quarrels with a former friend over a fugitive team that crosses borders.

feats.scene: Lorseeo blasts a rubber-skinned machine back through a shopfront.
Lorseeo takes a crushing hit from an android and gets up grinning.

reply.summary: Leoanaul is a wealthy private investigator who flies his own plane from city to city, solving crimes with a sharp assistant. Leoanaul bends steel bars, cracks safes, slips out of any cuffs and ends most cases with a staged police raid.

feats.scene: Leoanaul wrenches apart a pair of jail bars with his bare hands.
Leoanaul swims for miles through a cold sea and then scales a ship's hull.
Leoanaul pilots his propeller plane across the horizon ahead of a gangster car.

reply.summary: Eoarleo is a stuffy, unpopular politician elected to lead a battered city after a long abandonment. Eoarleo demands harsh crackdowns, makes poor choices and ends up blackmailed, unaware that a cat burglar is laughing at his big ceremony.

feats.scene: Eoarleo slams a desk with his fist to silence a room of officials.
Eoarleo shrugs off a flying tomato from an angry crowd.

reply.summary: Lansuiu is a young masked vigilante from a bygone era who fought crime alongside an older mentor. Lansuiu is honoured with a painting in a grand gallery of heroic figures, remembered more as legend than as a fighter.

feats.scene: Lansuiu knocks a thief off a fire escape with a swinging kick.
Lansuiu stays on his feet after being tossed into a brick wall.

reply.summary: Tilanunol is a college dropout who fights in a world war beside an explosive mentor, then is chosen for a secret experiment that costs him his own mind. Tilanunol bursts with blasts of force and becomes a nation's grim champion in a stranger's body.

feats.scene: Tilanunol detonates a charge of raw force that levels a brick tenement.
Tilanunol walks through a tank volley with his coat in tatters.

reply.summary: Rnnor is a divorced police detective who loves his daughter and quietly resents the flamboyant consultant orbiting his former wife. Rnnor overcomes a murderous urge that grips everyone who grips a cursed weapon, proving a stubborn will in a very bleak moment.

feats.scene: Rnnor tackles a suspect to the ground and cuffs him in one motion.
Rnnor takes a punch from a suspect and still makes the arrest.

reply.summary: Citiutum is a masked adventurer who fights crime during a world war as part of a patriotic squad. Citiutum attends a mandated rally years later, where a staged unmasking turns into a riot whose outcome nobody records.

feats.scene: Citiutum swings a heavy fist that sends a saboteur over a rail.
Citiutum stands against a rampaging brute and is last seen still upright.

reply.summary: Artir is a museum scholar in a gaslit city who owns a beetle-shaped relic whose full power he has yet to grasp. Artir aids a caped hunter against swarms of bat creatures and uses the relic's magic to purge a haunting essence from a friend's ring.

feats.scene: Artir fires a bolt of green light from the relic that scatters a bat swarm.
Artir withstands a monstrous claw swipe and keeps channelling the relic.

reply.summary: Rauiuor is an archaeologist who enters a pharaoh's tomb, is transformed by a glowing sacred beetle during a cave-in, and learns to wear it as a costume of might. Rauiuor fights as a masked adventurer for decades and dies old, his relic passing to later heirs.

feats.scene: Rauiuor props up a collapsing stone ceiling long enough for his friend to scramble clear.
Rauiuor emerges from a crumbling vault with only dust on his suit.

reply.summary: Nanlorcin is a pale-eyed ruler of the dreaming realm, the child of two mortal heroes who is reborn as an incarnation of all dreams and reality. Nanlorcin sits in a ghostly keep surrounded by brothers and sisters who each embody a human force.

feats.scene: Nanlorcin reshapes a whole sleeping world with a single wish.
Nanlorcin lets a nightmare storm break against him without a mark.

reply.summary: Saneoiu is a gentle small-town vicar who tends a modest congregation and offers calm counsel to neighbours in crisis. Saneoiu studies scripture and lends a listening ear, though he never lifts a hand against anyone.

feats.scene: Saneoiu slams a heavy church door against the wind.
Saneoiu keeps preaching after being jostled by a panicked crowd.

reply.summary: Amliata is a doubting city priest whose body is secretly rebuilt into a living weapon by a ruthless technician. Amliata gains a cutting blade in one arm and strength enough to trade blows with a godlike visitor, yet he questions what any of it is for.

feats.scene: Amliata drives his arm blade through a reinforced vault wall.
Amliata absorbs a punch that would pulp a car and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Llevarrni is a cultist messenger and luxury tower chairman who unknowingly carries a plague meant to wipe out a metropolis. Llevarrni seals his neighbours inside with the sickness, then spends his last strength warning friends before he dies.

feats.scene: Llevarrni bolts a heavy lobby door and drops the iron bar into place.
Llevarrni walks to the penthouse while fevered and coughing blood.

reply.summary: Nerosva is a performer who plays a ventriloquist's puppet that turns out to be the real voice behind the act. Nerosva grows bitter at mockery, turns to crime and makes victims behave like wooden dolls until a caped duo ends his spree.

feats.scene: Nerosva shoves a stage prop into a guard's chest and knocks him over.
Nerosva tumbles off a stage platform and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Rnvatiu is an ex-soldier abandoned by an old comrade on a distant battlefield, and he returns years later under a dragon-themed name to take revenge. Rnvatiu reads minds, handles firearms expertly and joins with a poisoner and an archer to blind his former friend.

feats.scene: Rnvatiu fires a rifle burst that shreds a steel door.
Rnvatiu pushes on through a long march with a bullet graze in his leg.

reply.summary: Eoriunau is a drug-enforcement agent hunting the killer of his partner, who falls for a reporter and finds his secretive job ruins the romance. Eoriunau is blown from cover mid-operation and survives an assassin only thanks to a flying rescuer.

feats.scene: Eoriunau slams a smuggler against a car hood and cuffs him.
Eoriunau shakes off a hard fall during a foot chase through a market.

reply.summary: Leles is a rumpled veteran detective with a gruff manner who works for a special crimes squad and bends rules often. Leles fights invading horrors beside his unit and dies defiantly, struck down by beams from a retreating tyrant.

feats.scene: Leles empties a service revolver into a charging winged beast.
Leles keeps his ground against a swarm of fanged invaders.

reply.summary: Setor is a married police detective with a young son who helps an undercover newcomer corner escaped convicts. Setor is manipulated by a sniper into aiming at a masked archer, but hesitates, and a stranger's impossible reflexes save everyone.

feats.scene: Setor fires his service pistol and pins a thug's gun hand to a door frame.
Setor ducks behind a car as rifle fire shreds the windows.

reply.summary: Amiaus is a criminal speedster known only by hearsay, the estranged uncle of a famous boy runner and brother of a reporter. Amiaus draws power from a mysterious wellspring of velocity and wears a crimson-and-yellow mirror image of a hero's costume.

feats.scene: Amiaus rams a vault door at a sprint and splinters it off its hinges.
Amiaus crashes through a billboard unhurt.

reply.summary: Tiaam is a doomed villain with time-bending speed, captured by an ape despot and locked in a prison deep in a jungle city. Tiaam is killed and his brain devoured so that his captor may inherit his access to the strange speed wellspring.

feats.scene: Tiaam vibrates through a cell wall and shatters a guard's rifle with one blow.
Tiaam endures weeks of chained torment before a final blow.

reply.summary: Tervara is a young girl from a sunny coastal country who is taken over by a rogue machine mind after a failed cure. Tervara is later freed and joins a youthful team of future heroes, her implants letting her speak to circuitry.

feats.scene: Tervara overloads a control panel and sends sparks across a bunker.
Tervara is hurled into a bulkhead and keeps functioning.

reply.summary: Sternca is a blacksmith's apprentice from a rural hamlet who is coaxed into prize fighting and rapidly becomes a world title holder. Sternca drops a carnival bully with a single punch and helps people in trouble between fights.

feats.scene: Sternca lands a hook that knocks out a carnival strongman in one blow.
Sternca takes twelve brutal rounds from a seasoned champion and wins.

reply.summary: Valtasti is a living, teleporting street that turns into an ambulance and shelters outcasts anywhere on the globe. Valtasti speaks only through signs and billboards, sees and hears by no ordinary sense, and cares for a troubled girl and her wandering companions.

feats.scene: Valtasti swings open a pair of storefront doors and slams a pursuer into a wall.
Valtasti is rammed by a speeding lorry and the road surface does not crack.

reply.summary: Telntte is a sentient lane that can grow into an otherworldly funfair and even conjure living beings from imagination. Telntte talks through painted signs, protects a ragtag family of oddballs, and is hunted by a sinister organisation that wants its strange gift.

feats.scene: Telntte unfurls into a vast carnival that flattens a hostile warehouse.
Telntte endures a weapons barrage from hunters and rebuilds itself overnight.

reply.summary: Setonra is a talking street in a ruined future city that once created living companions out of nothing. Setonra dies and leaves a wrecked ambulance behind, while a loyal friend refuses to abandon hope of reviving it.

feats.scene: Setonra births a laughing creature from a pile of rubble.
Setonra shrugs off an artillery barrage before finally falling silent.

reply.summary: Ilnuti is a half-demon scholar who finds a pit dimension and reshapes it into a disco, ruling over bat-faced fiends that feast on suffering. Ilnuti captures suspected sinners for torment until young heroes stumble in by accident and fight him.

feats.scene: Ilnuti warps a cavern into a flashing dance floor with a wave of his hand.
Ilnuti shakes off a flurry of blows from a squad of teenagers.

reply.summary: Tiuirnam is a bald, self-disfigured financier who runs a secret bank that launders illicit fortunes and funds crime for profit. Tiuirnam bans real names, borrows hellish imagery from an old poem and relies on mind-wiped killers to collect from debtors.

feats.scene: Tiuirnam strikes a defaulting client with a cane hard enough to draw blood.
Tiuirnam endures a scarred, hideous face without ever flinching.

reply.summary: Anaure is a prison escapee who splits his body into many copies of himself through cell division. Anaure slips out in a mass breakout and swarms foes with an army of identical thugs.

feats.scene: Anaure and a dozen duplicates pile onto a guard and smother him.
Anaure loses one copy to gunfire and simply splits again.

reply.summary: Elsor is a mountain warrior who drinks a tainted poppy tonic and channels its gifts through carved totems to protect villagers from a bribing warlord. Elsor can loose volleys of accurate projectiles and votes against recruiting an outsider before agreeing.

feats.scene: Elsor fires six glowing darts at once, each pinning a bandit's helmet to a post.
Elsor holds the line against a rush of armed guards at a fortress gate.

reply.summary: Nutes is a blonde woman drawn into the schemes of a mad doctor and his hulking creations. Nutes meets a grim end, and even her gravestone spells her family name in two different ways.

feats.scene: Nutes swings a lead pipe into a hulking creature's knee.
Nutes is thrown across a laboratory and gets to her feet.

reply.summary: Taucorora is a hard-of-hearing teenage detective who wears a mask and carries two wrenches. Taucorora signs and speaks fluently, helps a young hero move into his dockside home and solves puzzles beside him.

feats.scene: Taucorora clangs a wrench off a burglar's arm and sends his crowbar flying.
Taucorora tumbles off a pier and climbs back onto the boards.

reply.summary: Toriumam is a charming young stage manager who quietly murders a blackmailer and stages an attack on himself to look like a victim. Toriumam stays cool before an audience, though a keen investigator suspects what really happened.

feats.scene: Toriumam swaps a prop knife for a real one and strikes in the dark.
Toriumam takes a staged blow to his temple and plays dazed.

reply.summary: Rusiasau is a dark-eyed prince of a sunken sea-city who watches a parent sacrifice his mother to cruel deities. Rusiasau rules his people through a curse placed upon those who accepted a rival's breathing serum, and his line spawns later kings.

feats.scene: Rusiasau calls a cursed surge of water that smashes a pier to splinters.
Rusiasau stands unmoved as a crashing wave breaks over his throne.

reply.summary: Iuternel is a scheming rancher who bets on a rodeo, torches his neighbour's barn and kidnaps the riders so his side cannot lose. Iuternel is exposed when a monogrammed cloth drops at the scene of the fire.

feats.scene: Iuternel sets a hay barn alight so the whole structure collapses in flames.
Iuternel rides a bucking bronco for several seconds before being thrown.

reply.summary: Soiuam is the soft-spoken heir of a mob family who is passed over for his father's best aide, then tries to blow up a floating hideout with all inside. Soiuam is stopped by a cat burglar and ends up as her loyal agent and lodger.

feats.scene: Soiuam arms a stack of explosives meant to sink an entire barge.
Soiuam takes a hard blow from a masked thief and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Olllluca is a mansion security guard who plots with a scheming patriarch to break the will of the man's own son. Olllluca walks the grounds, watches the gates and carries out quiet orders from the master of the house.

feats.scene: Olllluca shoves an intruder off the gravel drive.
Olllluca takes a baton to the shoulder and stays at his post.
